description: This file defines a Java interface for system configuration services, extending generic entity service functionalities and providing a method to retrieve configuration by key.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationService
classes.description: A service interface for managing system configurations, extending generic service capabilities and adding method for retrieving configurations by key.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a SystemConfiguration object based on the provided key. Throws ServiceException if retrieval fails.
